sweep.title: Field Sweep Analysis
sweep.windowNoneRange: Window exists above sweep range. Expand to ~{max} {unit} to find it.
sweep.windowNoneImpossible: No window possible at current settings (max TI: {ti}x). Try lower frequency or wider pulses.
sweep.tipSweepLabel: Sweep Parameter Choose the physical quantity to vary on the x-axis.
sweep.tipFieldPill: E-field Sweep Varies field 0 → max at fixed RF frequency. Reveals minimum lysis field and therapeutic window.
sweep.tipFreqPill: Frequency Sweep Varies RF frequency 0 → max at fixed field. Shows Schwan roll-off and fc-dependent selectivity. Note: SAR is frequency-independent in this model.
sweep.tipMaxLabel: Sweep Maximum ({unit}) Upper limit of the sweep axis. Increase to reveal higher operating points.
sweep.tipExport: ↓ Export CSV Download all sweep data points. Columns: x · DR_H · DR_T · TI · T_H · T_T · in_window
sweep.tipChart: Field Sweep Chart Red = Target DR · Cyan = Healthy DR Amber dashed = TI (right axis) Green fill = Therapeutic window White cursor = current active value
sweep.tipThDrT: DR_T, Target Disruption Ratio Target DR at this operating point. DR = Vm × f_pulse / V_threshold 1.0 = lysis threshold crossed
sweep.tipThDrH: DR_H, Healthy Disruption Ratio Healthy DR at the same operating point. Keep below 0.50 for a safe therapeutic window.
